solves.reason: 독특한 의식(unique), 큰 존경(respect), 사랑을 즐김(enjoy)
solves.reasoning: a unique ritual / show great respect to bodies considered gifts / receive and enjoy the love → unique-respect-enjoy

solves.reason: 신선한 천(fresh), 죽은 친척(dead), 완전히 분해(completely)
solves.reasoning: wrapped in fresh cloth / remains of their dead relatives / break down completely → fresh-dead-completely

solves.reason: 조상을 기림(celebrate), 선물로 여김(gifts), 세상에 머묾(remain)
solves.reasoning: to celebrate their ancestors / considered gifts from forefathers / the dead remain in the world → celebrate-gifts-remain

solves.reason: ④ enjoy the fear는 부적절, 보여진 사랑(love)을 받고 즐김
solves.reasoning: receive and enjoy the ___ shown to them → 사랑(love)이어야 함, fear 부적절

solves.reason: ① family leaves는 부적절, 무덤에 들어가(enters) 뼈를 꺼냄
solves.reasoning: family ___ the tombs and brings out their bones → 들어가야(enters) 뼈를 꺼냄, leaves 부적절

solves.reason: ② little respect는 부적절, 선물로 여겨 큰(great) 존경을 보임
solves.reasoning: show ___ respect because bodies are considered gifts → 큰(great) 존경, little 부적절

solves.reason: music is played, and people ___ → 춤춘다(dance)
solves.reasoning: 음악이 연주되고 사람들이 유해와 함께 ___ → dance

solves.reason: dance with the ___ of their dead relatives → 유해(remains)
solves.reasoning: 앞서 뼈를 꺼낸 내용과 이어짐, 죽은 친척의 유해 → remains

solves.reason: ___ are not made from dust but from bodies of ancestors → 인간(humans)
solves.reasoning: 인간이 먼지가 아니라 조상의 몸에서 만들어진다는 믿음 → humans

solves.reason: unique(독특한) ≈ special
solves.reasoning: unique=독특한/유일한 → special; common은 반의어

solves.reason: respect(존경) ≈ honor
solves.reasoning: great respect to human bodies=존경 → honor; hatred는 반의

solves.reason: considered(여겨지는) ≈ regarded
solves.reasoning: be considered gifts=~로 여겨지다 → regarded

solves.reason: dead(죽은) ↔ living(살아있는)
solves.reasoning: dead relatives=죽은 → 반대 living; buried는 같은 축

solves.reason: completely(완전히) ↔ partially(부분적으로)
solves.reasoning: break down completely=완전히 → 반대 partially; totally는 동의어 함정

solves.reason: (A) festival held=열린/개최된, (B) held child=붙잡은
solves.reasoning: A는 축제가 개최되다, B는 아이를 붙잡다/안다 → 열린-붙잡은

solves.reason: 돌로 지어진, 죽은 사람이 묻히는 큰 무덤 → tomb
solves.reasoning: a large grave in which a dead person is buried → tomb(무덤)

solves.reason: 명사 ritual을 수식하는 과거분사(수동) → practiced
solves.reasoning: a unique ritual ___ (practice) by people → 과거분사 수식 practiced

solves.reason: to be + 과거분사 수동태 부정사 → wrapped
solves.reasoning: bones to be ___ (wrap) → 'to be + p.p.' 수동 부정사 wrapped

solves.reason: the dead remain until their bodies ___ → 완전히 분해되다
solves.reasoning: 다음 문장 Until this happens와 이어짐, 몸이 완전히 분해될 때까지 → break down completely

solves.reason: show respect because they are ___ → 조상이 준 선물로 여겨지는
solves.reasoning: 존경을 보이는 이유 → considered gifts from their forefathers
